name: OA057
quantifiers: For every connected smooth projective complex variety X of every dimension n>=0, every finite collection of distinct smooth irreducible divisors D_1,...,D_s whose union is simple normal crossing, and every tuple of integers m_i>=2, let R be the simultaneous root orbifold sqrt[m_i]{(X,D_i)}. If R is special in the differential-line sense, then the entire discrete group pi_1(X minus union D_i)/normal_closure(gamma_i^{m_i}) is virtually abelian. The empty boundary and n=0 are included.
specialness: No orbifold line bundle L with a nonzero map L -> Omega_R^p and kappa(L)=p, for any integer 1<=p<=dim X.
stipulated_input: Manifold abelianity in every dimension, pinned OpenAI source family057, fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb.
no_extra_hypotheses: no divisibility of D_i in Pic(X)
no bound on number of divisors
no prime or prime-power restriction on m_i
no uniform bound on abelian subgroup index claimed
construction_target: For every such root orbifold, without specialness, construct a connected smooth projective Y mapping to it, with connected abelian-variety general fibre and local submersive lifts over the general point of every base prime divisor; derive specialness transfer and surjection on the displayed orbifold group.
mechanism: Auxiliary Kummer cover with n+1 branch divisors per component; common root exponent M=lcm(m_i); pairwise affine cyclic permutation actions on E^M with diagonal exact-M torsion detect repeated nonzero inertia coordinates; inertia-trivial root-line descent through coarse quotient; proper resolution and lifted local fixed-point sections recover auxiliary-divisor submersions.
formal_feasibility: Finite cyclic shifts on functions ZMod M -> additive group; exact-M torsion diagonal translation; commuting generator formula and equal-exponent fixed-point obstruction; finite subset cardinality yielding two absent auxiliary indices. These are honest feasible supporting interfaces only. No claim that root stacks, resolution, specialness transfer, or full OA057 can be formalized in available mathlib.
unchanged_target: This JSON fixes the original all-dimension, all-order, full-SNC target. If an interface fails, record unpaid/failed rather than substitute prime roots, disjoint boundary, smaller dimension or linear images.
